This position is located at Grand Canyon National Park. The purpose of the positions is to support stabilization, reopening, planning, and redevelopment of the North Rim of the Grand Canyon post-Dragon Bravo Fire as well as the management of a Legacy Restoration Fund project to replace critical infrastructure on the North Rim.

This work is critical for rebuilding and fully restoring visitor access on the North Rim, which is identified as a temporary need.

Major Duties: Serves as a Project Manager, working with interdisciplinary teams and providing professional engineering/architectural advice and guidance on the planning, designing, constructing, expansion, rehabilitation and/or re-purposing of existing and/or new structures, facilities, and utilities, roads, trails, and other physical assets.

Project Scoping, Data, and Asset Management: Identifies need and develops justification for project, collects data, identifies project scope, conducts cost estimating and project entry into systems, databases, and other project management tools for prioritization, funding requests, and status updates, and acquires funding for project planning, supplemental services, support functions, and implementation, and remediation.

Project Formulation and Pre-Design: Work includes revisiting needs and assumptions driving the project to verify that the proposed solution is appropriate and feasible, follows NPS design and construction protocol for the appropriate fund source, and works with regional and/or park staff to address requirements such as compliance, sustainability, and code requirements.

Schematic Design and Value Based Decision Making: Assists with the development of schematic design alternatives, supports the park's initiation and completion of environmental compliance activities, develops a preferred alternative based on the outcomes of Value Analysis, and incorporates value-based decision-making methodology in project management and decision-making activities.

Design Development and Construction Documents: Participates in the design process to meet project goals to include: technical review of detailed design drawings, review of construction specifications to current industry standards, prepares and reviews cost estimates and other technical documentation required to contract and award project.

Technical Resource/Expertise: Provides technical reviews of plans within area of expertise and provides project information and status updates through various channels to include: verbal and written briefings/presentation, providing information for project websites, news releases, civic engagement opportunities, and interviews.

Contracting Support: Works closely with the CO and/or the AE to assemble all documentation required (including scope of work) to contract and award the project, works with the CO to provide site visits and addressing questions from contractors, evaluation of proposals received, approval of contract modifications, and acquire, maintain, and perform COR duties as needed.

This is a term position (more than 1 year) with an initial appointment expecting to last at least 13 months but may be extended up to a total of ten years, or more based on any changes to regulations governing the number of years term appointments may last, without further competition.

Term positions do not convey permanent status in the Federal service. The National Park Service retains the right to extend the duration of this appointment after selection and/or appointment, based on changes to the regulation governing the number of years term appointments may last.

This change, which may be made at the agency's sole discretion and without further competition, shall not be construed or interpreted as the granting of a right to a selectee or employee to such an extension.

No extension to a term appointment shall be granted to a selectee/employee to an amount of time that exceeds the maximum number of years authorized under any present or current regulation, unless such regulation expressly allows such action.
Requirements Continued... As a condition of employment for accepting this position, you will be required to serve a 2-year trial period during which your fitness and whether your continued employment advances the public interest will be evaluated.

This trial period is an extension of the appointment process and therefore requires the agency to determine if continued employment would advance the public interest, meet the organization goals and mission of the agency, and/or otherwise promote the efficiency of the service.

In determining if your employment advances the public interest, the agency will consider: your performance and conduct; the needs and interests of the agency; whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service.

Under applicable law, the employment of an individual serving a probationary or trial period automatically terminates when that period ends unless the agency affirmatively certifies, in writing, that the individual's employment should continue and that their appointment should be finalized.

In the absence of agency action to affirmatively certify continued employment beyond the probationary or trial period, such appointments are terminated. Upon completion of your trial period your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest.

All qualifications must be met by the closing date of this announcement-07/23/2026-unless otherwise stated in this vacancy announcement. Credit will be given for all appropriate qualifying experience.

To receive credit for experience, your resume MUST clearly indicate the nature of the duties and responsibilities for each position, starting and ending dates of employment (month/year), and the resume must reflect full and/or part-time or total number of hours worked (i.e., work 40+ hours a week, rather than indicating full-time).

If part-time, the hours must be annotated to be able to pro-rate the amount of qualified specialized experience. BASIC REQUIREMENTS: This position has basic requirements required by the Office of Personnel Management. Candidates who do not meet this requirement by close of this announcement will receive no further consideration for this position.

It is recommended to upload all transcripts you have to justify this requirement (under grad, grad, etc.).

Applicants must meet one of the following before the close of the announcement: Individual Occupational Requirements for a General Engineer GS-0801, Civil Engineer GS-0810, or Mechanical Engineer GS-0830 EDUCATION: Successfully completed a full 4-year course of study in an accredited college or university leading to a bachelor's or higher degree in engineering.

To be acceptable, the program must: (1) lead to a bachelor's degree in a school of engineering with at least one program accredited by ABET; or (2) include differential and integral calculus and courses (more advanced than first-year physics and chemistry) in five of the following seven areas of engineering science or physics: (a) statics, dynamics; (b) strength of materials (stress-strain relationships); (c) fluid mechanics, hydraulics; (d) thermodynamics; (e) electrical fields and circuits; (f) nature and properties of materials (relating particle and aggregate structure to properties); and (g) any other comparable area of fundamental engineering science or physics, such as optics, heat transfer, soil mechanics, or electronics. -OR- A combination of education and experience -- college-level education, training, and/or technical experience that furnished (1) a thorough knowledge of the physical and mathematical sciences underlying engineering, and (2) a good understanding, both theoretical and practical, of the engineering sciences and techniques and their applications to one of the branches of engineering.

The adequacy of such background must be demonstrated by one of the following: 1. Professional registration or licensure -- Current registration as an Engineer Intern (EI), Engineer in Training (EIT)1, or licensure as a Professional Engineer (PE) by any State, the District of Columbia, Guam, or Puerto Rico.

Absent other means of qualifying under this standard, those applicants who achieved such registration by means other than written test (e.g., State grandfather or eminence provisions) are eligible only for positions that are within or closely related to the specialty field of their registration.

For example, an applicant who attains registration through a State Board's eminence provision as a manufacturing engineer typically would be rated eligible only for manufacturing engineering positions. 2.

Written Test -- Evidence of having successfully passed the Fundamentals of Engineering (FE)2 examination or any other written test required for professional registration by an engineering licensure board in the various States, the District of Columbia, Guam, and Puerto Rico. 3.

Specified academic courses -- Successful completion of at least 60 semester hours of courses in the physical, mathematical, and engineering sciences and that included the courses specified in the basic requirements. The courses must be fully acceptable toward meeting the requirements of an engineering program as described in paragraph A. 4.

Related curriculum -- Successful completion of a curriculum leading to a bachelor's degree in an appropriate scientific field, e.g., engineering technology, physics, chemistry, architecture, computer science, mathematics, hydrology, or geology, may be accepted in lieu of a bachelor's degree in engineering, provided the applicant has had at least 1 year of professional engineering experience acquired under professional engineering supervision and guidance.

Ordinarily there should be either an established plan of intensive training to develop professional engineering competence, or several years of prior professional engineering-type experience, e.g., in interdisciplinary positions.

(The above examples of related curricula are not all inclusive.) OR Individual Occupational Requirements for a Landscape Architect GS-0807 EDUCATION: Successfully completed a full 4-year course of study in an accredited college or university leading to a bachelor's or higher degree in landscape architecture or landscape design. -OR- A combination of education and experience -- for each year short of graduation, the applicant must have had 1 year of experience under professional leadership and guidance of such character and diversity as to be a satisfactory substitute for the required education.

This experience must have included original landscape design. OR * * Continued below in Education **

Serves within Defense Logistics Agency (DLA), Information Operations J62 Program Executive Office (PEO), J62X System Applications and Products (SAP) Platform, specifically in Warehouse Management System (WMS) Portfolio (J62XD).
Serves as the Equipment Control Systems (ECS), SAP Material Flow Systems (MFS) and all automation IT Project Manager for WMS Portfolio delivering and sustaining WMS (Extended Warehouse Management (EWM)...
... Transportation Management (TM), ERP Central Component (ECC), S/4HANA, Fiori, etc) across the DLA Major Subordinate Commands (MSCs) (Distribution, Disposition Services, etc).
Provides project management oversight for the integration and deployment of Enterprise business capabilities utilizing Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) and Government Off-The-Shelf (GOTS) packages...
... such as WMS, ECS, Warehouse Control Systems (WCS), Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC), MFS, and physical warehouse automation solutions.
Oversees control configurations for conveyor systems, Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (AS/RS), scanners, and sensors to coordinate real-time physical movements of handling units (HUs).
Leads the integration and deployment of SAP AutoStore within SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM).
Manages projects to implement cube-based automated storage system, coordinating the alignment of robotic physical movements, grid configurations...
...., and workstation (port) interfaces to support high-efficiency "goods-to-person" picking and replenishment.
Leads and manages the development and execution of comprehensive IT project plans, integrated schedules, risk mitigations, and knowledge transfer artifacts for all automation and hardware-integration initiatives.
Maintains critical communications and situational awareness of automation project scopes, resource requirements, and milestone statuses with all stakeholders, including team members, senior leadership, and DLA customer networks.
Facilitates direct collaboration between DLA warehouse operators, technical subject matter experts, and hardware vendors to align physical automation requirements with core software capabilities.
Monitors, tracks, and manages project milestones and system integration defects utilizing the Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) tool.
Evaluates project progress, system effectiveness, and delivery quality, developing targeted tools and methods to track automation life-cycle milestones.
Coordinates the integration of automation workflows with inbound, outbound, and internal logistics processes across DLA Distribution, Disposition Services, and military services within SAP S/4, ECC, EWM, TM, and Fiori.
Represents the agency at meetings and conferences involving senior level personnel throughout Department of War (DoW), other government agencies and private industry.
Provides support in achieving DLA audit readiness goals and objectives to include direct support to audit readiness teams through the completion of specific tasks and deliverables.
To qualify for an IT Project Manager (SYSANALYSIS) your resume and supporting documentation must support: A. Specialized Experience: One year of specialized experience that equipped you with the particular competencies to successfully perform the duties of the position, and is directly in or related to this position.

To qualify at the GS-13 level, applicants must possess one year of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-12 level or equivalent under other pay systems in the Federal service, military or private sector.

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements including time-in-grade (General Schedule (GS) positions only), time-after-competitive appointment, minimum qualifications, and any other regulatory requirements by the cut-off/closing date of the announcement.

Creditable specialized experience includes: - Provides specific expertise in the areas of IT Project Management, policies, principals, methods and practices to define project resources, milestones and deliverables; develop IT System interoperability test plans and schedules for the modernization of warehouse automation, including transitioning from legacy Equipment Control Systems (ECS) to SAP Material Flow Systems (MFS) and modern hardware integrations. - Leads and executes interoperability IT testing strategy concurrently spanning multi-disciplined project teams to integrate enterprise software (SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM)) with physical warehouse automation hardware, such as Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (AS/RS), and cube-based robotic storage (AutoStore). - Supports analysis of data and comparable activities in support of goals and objectives related to high levels of program and project management as supported by the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and hardware integration lifecycles, ensuring continuous, real-time routing, capacity monitoring, and malfunction reporting for automated systems. - Assures industry standard project management methodology is implemented for maximum effectiveness, efficiency and success of assigned IT projects, driving seamless interoperability between SAP environments and modern automation tools, sensors, and scanners while safely phasing out legacy control infrastructure.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social).

Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Provides program and project management support to the Division and district personnel.
Responsible for all programs management and funds control functions of the Military, IIS, and HTRW programs.
Recommend priorities within the limits of resources to ensure proper project execution and financial balance.
Oversee preparation of data for the District's annual workload forecasting effort and consolidate programming data into the AIS for future resource planning.
Participate in policy development and program planning for Division-wide activities to ensure district policy conforms to existing precedents, practices, and guidelines.
Serve as the District's staff authority and consultant on program management, providing expert advice on program policy, funding, scheduling, and manpower to the District Commander and Deputy District Engineer.
Oversee and lead District efforts to meet initiatives of transforming the organization in regard to governance, business practices, and data analytics.
Represent the District and provide advice and guidance on program and project operations, negotiating with concerned parties to gain compliance with established policies.
Provide leadership and strategic recommendations to senior management regarding the Military, HTRW, IIS, and Civil Works programs and budget allocations.
Supervise the PPCO workforce and work operation, planning and scheduling the office's work and making assignments based on capabilities, priorities, and project difficulty.
Initiate and submit requests for personnel actions, select candidates for PPCO positions, establish performance objectives, evaluate employee performance, and initiate performance awards.
Interpret and determine the impact of pertinent legislation on the District's programs, projects, and budget formulations to ensure compliance.
Who May Apply: Only applicants who meet one of the employment authority categories below are eligible to apply for this job. You will be asked to identify which category or categories you meet, and to provide documents which prove you meet the category or categories you selected.

See Proof of Eligibility for an extensive list of document requirements for all employment authorities.

Current Department of Army Civilian Employees Domestic Defense Industrial Base/Major Range and Test Facilities Base Civilian Personnel Workforce Interagency Career Transition Assistance Plan Land Management Workforce Flexibility Act Military Spouses, under Executive Order (E.O.) 13473 Priority Placement Program, DoD Military Reserve (MR) and National Guard (NG) Technician Eligible Priority Placement Program, DoD Military Spouse Preference (MSP) Eligible Priority Placement Program, DoD MR and NG Preference Eligible Tech Receiving Disability Retirement Priority Placement Program, DoD Retained Grade Preference Eligible Veterans Employment Opportunity Act (VEOA) of 1998 In order to qualify, you must meet the experience requirements described below.

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional; philanthropic; religious; spiritual; community; student; social). You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience.

Your resume must clearly describe your relevant experience; if qualifying based on education, your transcripts will be required as part of your application. Additional information about transcripts is in this document.

You must also meet the specialized experience as indicated in the below statement: Specialized Experience Statement: One year of specialized experience which includes managing and coordinating complex programs or projects; analyzing funding, resource requirements, schedules, and performance to support program execution; providing advice and recommendations on complex program management issues; and coordinating with senior leaders and stakeholders to resolve issues and achieve organizational objectives.

This definition of specialized experience is typical of work performed at the next lower grade/level position in the federal service (GS-13).

You will be evaluated on the basis of your level of competency in the following areas: Accountability Customer Service Decisiveness Flexibility Interpersonal Skills Problem Solving Resilience Time in Grade Requirement: Applicants who have held a General Schedule (GS) position within the last 52 weeks must have 52 weeks of Federal service at the next lower grade or equivalent (GS-13).

Aufgaben
Projektleitung: Eigenverantwortliche technische, organisatorische und wirtschaftliche Leitung anspruchsvoller Stahlbauprojekte von der Planung bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.
Angebots- und Auftragsmanagement: Erstellung technischer Angebote und Kalkulationen sowie Verantwortung für die wirtschaftliche Steuerung und Entwicklung der Projekte.
Koordination und Führung: Verantwortung für die bereichsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit sowie die Führung der am Projekt beteiligten Teams.
Qualitäts- und Normensicherung: Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller relevanten Normen, Richtlinien und Qualitätsstandards sowie Durchführung von Baustellenbegehungen.
Kunden- und Lieferantenbetreuung: Aufbau und Pflege langfristiger Kunden- und Lieferantenbeziehungen sowie technische Beratung und Betreuung der Kunden während des gesamten Projekts.
Qualifikation
Qualifikation: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Bauingenieurwesen mit Schwerpunkt Stahlbau oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer leitenden Position im Stahlbau.
Führungskompetenz: Erfahrung in der fachlichen oder disziplinarischen Führung von Mitarbeitern oder Projektteams.
Technisches Fachwissen: Fundierte Kenntnisse im Stahlbau sowie der einschlägigen deutschen Normen, Richtlinien und Vorschriften.
Kommunikationsstärke: Sicheres Auftreten, ausgeprägte Organisationsfähigkeit sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

The United States Space Force (USSF) at Clear Space Force Station, Alaska is searching for a IT/Cyber COR/QA Program Manager to support 13 SWS (OBN) (NH-2210-03, GS-12/13 equivalent).

Description: Manages the Information Technology (IT)/Cyber Communications (Comm) Quality Assurance (QA) Program and performs QA evaluation and documentation of contractor performance.

Conducts inspections in Communications Operations, Computer Operations, Radar Maintenance, Computer Maintenance, Site Maintenance Management, LAN/WAN, Site Security Systems, Administrative Telephone Systems, and other assigned areas.

Determines contractor compliance with technical directives, quality, safety, timeliness, Air Force Instructions, and other contract requirements.

Develops the inspection schedule for contractor-supplied services and maintains/updates Quality Assurance Surveillance Plans (QASPs), Statements of Work (SOWs), contract modifications, inspection logs, and activity records.

Assesses policy needs and develops, approves, and interprets policy and procedures governing Information Technology (IT) and cybersecurity activities.

Serves as the Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM), establishing, maintaining, and enforcing the organization's cybersecurity program in accordance with the DoD Risk Management Framework (RMF), DoDI 8500.01, DoDI 8510.01, and applicable Air Force/Space Force cybersecurity guidance.

Interprets DoD, AF, and higher headquarters guidance and applies it locally, coordinating across organizations to develop, revise, and modify policies and assessing impacts on business requirements.

Manages the Assessment and Authorization (A&A) process, prepares and maintains system security authorization packages, and supports Authorizing Official (AO) decisions to achieve and sustain Authorizations to Operate (ATO) Provides technical expertise in the acquisition and installation of large, complex operating system environments, including personal computers, LAN servers, components, and associated software.

Independently oversees testing, migration, and cutover with minimal disruption and provides post-implementation support. Ensures appropriate configuration and sufficient system resources for new applications. Establishes project plans, priorities, and implementation schedules to ensure continuity of operations.

Evaluates operating system design requirements and consults with developers on impacts to end-user applications. Oversees hardware/software setup and configuration per the technical design plan, coordinating installation and sustainment with IT, telecommunications specialists, and the database manager.

Serves as the Contracting Officer's Representative (COR) for the installation Comm/Cyber contract, performing contract administration duties designated in the CO's Letter of Designation.

Prepares Corrective Action Reports (CARs), documents deficiencies, analyzes contractor responses for root cause and corrective actions, and performs follow-up to resolution. Reviews technical specifications, requirements, and procurement request documents; leads technical proposal reviews; and determines adequacy of vendor capability.

Serves as liaison between the Commander, Contracting Officer, contractor, Director of Mission Assurance, and other Air Force/Space Force personnel.

Coordinates with the SCIF Manager, SSO, security personnel, and Authorizing Official chain on personnel access, SCI indoctrination, cybersecurity risk, and security incidents, violations, or deviations affecting information systems and the SCIF. Participates in meetings to resolve problems, discuss procedures, and review contractor performance.

Notifies the Senior Quality Assurance Evaluator, supervisor, and Contract Quality Program Manager of deficiencies, prepares file documentation, and recommends changes to surveillance methods as warranted.

Ideal Candidate: Purpose: The purpose of this position is to support the Communications and Cyber Quality Assurance (QA) program by providing the unit commander, director, and senior leadership with a comprehensive assessment of the unit's ability to perform key logistics processes.

This is accomplished by ensuring standardized, repeatable, and technically compliant process execution, while promoting a culture of professional excellence and personal responsibility. The primary focus is on personnel proficiency and adherence to established policies and procedures.
The 2210 series has an individual occupational requirement that must be met and can be viewed here. There is no Group Coverage Qualification Standard for this series.

Ihre Karriere im technischen Projektmanagement.
Mit BRÜGGEN ENGINEERING unterstützen Sie anspruchsvolle Projekte im industriellen Umfeld und übernehmen frühzeitig Verantwortung für eigene Teilprojekte. Sie koordinieren Projektabläufe, sorgen für transparente Prozesse und tragen dazu bei, Projekte effizient und erfolgreich umzusetzen.
Aufgaben
Projektmanagement: Sie unterstützen die Projektleitung im Tagesgeschäft und übernehmen eigenverantwortlich Teilprojekte.
Projektplanung: Sie erstellen und pflegen Zeitpläne, Meilensteine sowie Maßnahmenlisten und verfolgen den Projektfortschritt.
Projektcontrolling: Sie überwachen Termine, Risiken und offene Aufgaben und unterstützen eine zielgerichtete Projektsteuerung.
Koordination: Sie stimmen sich bereichsübergreifend mit Produktion, Logistik, Supply Chain Management und Qualitätssicherung ab.
Meetings: Sie bereiten Besprechungen vor und nach, erstellen Präsentationen sowie Protokolle und verfolgen vereinbarte Maßnahmen.
Dokumentation: Sie strukturieren Projektunterlagen und pflegen Projektdaten in SharePoint, Planner und weiteren Projektmanagement-Tools.
Prozessentwicklung: Sie unterstützen bei der Einführung und Weiterentwicklung abteilungsübergreifender Projektmanagement-Methoden und Softwarelösungen.
Qualifikation
Qualifikation: Abgeschlossene technische Weiterbildung oder Studium, z. B. im Maschinenbau, in der Produktionstechnik oder Logistik, ergänzt durch einschlägige Berufserfahrung
Erfahrung: praktische Erfahrung im Projektmanagement oder im Produktions- / Logistikumfeld, einschließlich Trouble-Shooting
Projektmanagement: Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel, sowie Erfahrung mit MS Teams, SharePoint, Planner; Kenntnisse in MS Project sind von Vorteil
Arbeitsweise: Strukturierte, proaktive und eigenverantwortliche Herangehensweise mit ausgeprägtem Organisationsgeschick
Kommunikation: Kommunikationsstärke sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen
Sprachen: Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2)

Attraktive Konditionen: Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit einer Vergütung, die Ihrer Qualifikation und Erfahrung entspricht
Zukunftssichere Projekte: Arbeiten Sie an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten im Produktions- und Logistikumfeld und übernehmen Sie frühzeitig Verantwortung
Dynamisches Team: Kollegiales Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit
Angabe Ihres frühesten Starttermins und Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung.

Why Thunderbird?
Thunderbird is one of the world’s most trusted open-source email applications, empowering more than 20 million people globally. At MZLA, the team behind Thunderbird, we build privacy-respecting communication and productivity tools that help people manage their digital lives while staying in control of their data.
We are open source by design. Our products are developed transparently and in collaboration with a global community of contributors, and that same spirit shapes how we work: collaboratively, inclusively, and with a shared commitment to putting users first.
We are a small but growing company of 60+ people distributed across seven countries. As Thunderbird evolves beyond a single desktop application, we are expanding across desktop, mobile, paid services, and new product experiences that help people and organizations work more effectively without giving up control to big tech ecosystems.
Our revenue model combines user donations, which help keep Thunderbird’s apps freely available, with paid services that cover the costs of hosted offerings while supporting long-term sustainability and continued innovation.
A note about MZLA and Mozilla: MZLA Technologies Corporation is the nonprofit-owned company behind Thunderbird and part of the Mozilla family. MZLA is separate from Mozilla Corporation and has its own compensation programs, benefits, and employment policies.
To learn more, visit www.thunderbird.net
The opportunity
Thunderbird is growing beyond our free desktop and mobile applications, and we’re looking for a Senior Privacy & Compliance Program Manager to help build and strengthen the privacy, compliance, data governance, and vendor review practices that support MZLA’s products and operations.
Privacy and compliance are central to how we build and maintain user trust, particularly for a global user base with a significant presence in Europe.

As MZLA expands its products and services, this role will help ensure that data is collected, used, shared, retained, and governed responsibly, in line with Thunderbird’s values and user trust commitments.

You will help translate privacy, security, and compliance requirements into practical processes that fit our products and services, infrastructure, support workflows, vendor ecosystem, and operating model.
MZLA is a small, growing organization, and the right person will be a hands-on program manager who can create structure without overcomplicating the work. You will work across legal, engineering, product, support, finance, operations, and other Mozilla-wide partners to clarify ownership, track open items, identify when issues need escalation, and keep cross-functional privacy and compliance work moving.
This role requires strong judgment, excellent follow-through, and the ability to operate across legal, technical, operational, and leadership contexts. You will help ensure privacy and compliance work is well coordinated, appropriately documented, and grounded in practical processes that support user trust and responsible product development.
This role requires regular overlap with Eastern Time working hours for meetings, collaboration, and time-sensitive coordination. We welcome candidates in other time zones who can consistently maintain meaningful overlap with ET.

Coordinate MZLA’s privacy and compliance program work, including planning, recurring reviews, risk tracking, documentation, and leadership reporting.
Translate privacy, security, and compliance requirements into practical processes that fit how MZLA works.
Coordinate vendor and tool reviews with legal, engineering, product, support, finance, operations, and other stakeholders.
Help document data flows, subprocessors, and privacy, security, contractual, and operational considerations.
Support privacy operations and data governance for a global user base, including DSAR and privacy-rights workflows.
Help develop and maintain practical data inventories, records of processing, retention practices, and privacy-related documentation.
Partner with technical teams to support privacy-by-design practices for new products, services, tools, and data-processing activities.
Support compliance and audit-readiness efforts, including ISO-related readiness, evidence tracking, access reviews, and remediation follow-up.
Help strengthen incident response readiness by clarifying roles, escalation paths, documentation expectations, and coordination needs.
Build lightweight guidance, checklists, templates, and training materials that help teams meet privacy and compliance expectations without creating unnecessary bureaucracy.

8+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably within a software, SaaS, technology, or technical product environment.
5+ years of direct or closely related hands-on experience in privacy operations, compliance program management, GRC, legal operations, security compliance, vendor governance, data governance, or a similar function.
Experience coordinating cross-functional programs across legal, engineering, product, support, finance, and operations teams, including work with external counsel, advisors, auditors, consultants, or vendors to move complex work forward.
Experience supporting vendor, tool, or subprocessor reviews, including privacy, security, legal, and operational risk considerations.
Experience supporting privacy operations, data governance, or user-rights workflows for products or services with international users, including areas such as GDPR or EU privacy requirements, DSARs, deletion or export requests, data inventories, records of processing, retention, access controls, or privacy policy maintenance.
Technical fluency and the ability to work with technical teams to understand how data moves through systems, including cloud services, vendor tools, support systems, logs, telemetry, authentication, access permissions, and data storage.
Familiarity with incident response, breach readiness, or security/privacy escalation processes.
Strong project and program management skills, excellent written communication, sound judgment, and the ability to build pragmatic, right-sized processes for a small but growing organization.
Ability to learn, evaluate, and responsibly use emerging technologies, including AI-enabled tools, to improve work processes.
Ability to operate with initiative in areas where processes are still evolving, including identifying stakeholders, proposing next steps, clarifying ownership, and knowing when to escalate.

Die impulsarbeit gmbh entwickelt in Winterthur ein neues Förderprogramm für junge Frauen mit Fluchthintergrund.
Ziel ist die persönliche, gesellschaftliche und wirtschaftliche Emanzipation der Teilnehmerinnen. Die Frauen sollen ihre Ressourcen und Handlungsmöglichkeiten erweitern und schrittweise die Voraussetzungen schaffen, ihr Leben selbstbestimmt und möglichst unabhängig von staatlicher Unterstützung gestalten zu können.
Für den Aufbau und die fachliche Entwicklung des Programms suchen wir per 1. Oktober 2026 eine Projektleiterin (40 %). Die Stelle ist zunächst auf ein Jahr befristet.
Ein Programm mit Zeit für Entwicklung
Für die Aufbau- und Entwicklungsphase stehen substanzielle private Mittel zur Verfügung. Dadurch kann das Programm ohne kurzfristigen Finanzierungs-, Vermittlungs- oder Mengendruck entwickelt werden.
Unterschiedliche Ansätze können sorgfältig erprobt, ausgewertet und weiterentwickelt werden. Eine externe Wirkungsmessung begleitet das Programm und stellt sicher, dass Erkenntnisse systematisch in die kontinuierliche Qualitätsentwicklung einfliessen.
Ziel ist ein fachlich fundiertes, lernendes und langfristig anschlussfähiges Fördermodell. Die Zusammenarbeit mit Gemeinden, Kanton, Fachstellen und bestehenden Integrationsstrukturen ist ausdrücklich erwünscht.
Zwei Arbeitstage – zwei unterschiedliche Erfahrungsräume
Die 40%-Stelle verteilt sich grundsätzlich auf zwei Arbeitstage pro Woche.
1. Tag: Förderung, Arbeitsintegration und Fallarbeit
Die Teilnehmerinnen arbeiten in einem realen betrieblichen Umfeld und sammeln konkrete Arbeitserfahrungen. Die Projektleiterin begleitet diesen Prozess fachlich und individuell.

· arbeitsintegrative Begleitung

· individuelle Förderplanung

· Fallarbeit

· Erkennen und Aktivieren vorhandener Ressourcen

· Reflexion der Erfahrungen im Betrieb

· Entwicklung beruflicher und persönlicher Perspektiven

· Zusammenarbeit mit Betrieben, Fachstellen und weiteren Beteiligten

· Planung geeigneter nächster Entwicklungsschritte
2. Tag: Waldtag und individuelles Coaching
Der zweite Tag schafft bewusst einen anderen Rahmen. Ein Teil des Tages findet gemeinsam im Wald statt. Natur, Bewegung, gemeinsames Tun und Gespräche eröffnen andere Zugänge zu Ressourcen, Beziehungen und persönlichen Themen.
Ergänzend finden individuelle Coachings statt. Hier können persönliche Ziele, aktuelle Herausforderungen, Ressourcen und nächste Schritte vertieft bearbeitet werden.
Beide Tage gehören zusammen: konkrete Erfahrung und Arbeitsintegration auf der einen Seite, Reflexion, individuelle Entwicklung und Stabilisierung auf der anderen.
Fachlicher Hintergrund
Wir suchen eine Frau mit einem Abschluss in Sozialer Arbeit FH oder einem fundierten fachlichen Hintergrund in kunstbasierten, kunstpädagogischen oder kunsttherapeutischen Methoden.

s.h: Von Vorteil sind Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrungen mit

At Immense Group , we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about iGaming and tech development bold in your approach, and act with integrity, we’d love for you to join our team as a Technical Project Manager.

s.h: A taste of what you’ll do
s.t:
The Technical Project Manager is responsible for leading complex, high-impact projects and programs that span multiple departments, regions, or product lines. This role combines strategic leadership, technical expertise, and operational excellence to deliver projects that drive organizational growth and innovation.
The Technical Project Manager ensures alignment between business strategy and project execution, mentors mid-level PMs, and influences key stakeholders across technical, operational, and executive levels. This role is central to fostering project management excellence, implementing advanced methodologies, and leveraging technology — including AI-enabled tools — to improve delivery and decision-making.
End-to-end project delivery
Own and manage the full lifecycle of complex and cross-functional projects, ensuring delivery on time, within scope, and within budget.
Lead strategic initiatives such as market entries, platform enhancements, certifications, and product launches.
Coordinate dependencies and deliverables across multiple departments.
Strategic roadmap alignment
Partner with senior leadership and product teams to translate strategic objectives into structured project plans.
Support roadmap prioritization by assessing feasibility, risks, and business impact.
Ensure that project outcomes align with organizational targets and regulatory requirements.
Cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management
Lead and influence cross-department teams — including Product, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, Commercial, BI, and Engineering — facilitating effective collaboration and resolving conflicts across multi-team initiatives.
Mentor junior Project Managers and contribute to raising the maturity of the PM function.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior leadership, external partners, vendors, and regulatory contacts, providing clear communication, alignment, and expectation-setting throughout the project lifecycle.
Manage project decisions and escalate critical issues when necessary.
Risk management and governance
Develop and maintain strategic risk frameworks to identify, assess, and mitigate project risks.
Lead risk workshops, implement contingency plans, and ensure compliance with internal governance processes.
Oversee change control procedures to maintain project stability during implementation.
Technical delivery oversight
Demonstrate strong technical understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), integrations, technical architecture, and backend/frontend concepts.
Support technical teams by clarifying requirements, resolving blockers, and ensuring technical milestones are achieved.
Translate technical information into business language for stakeholders and executives.
Compliance and regulatory support
Collaborate with Compliance, Legal, and Risk teams to ensure alignment with iGaming regulatory standards for new markets and existing operations.
Support or lead regulatory-focused projects such as security audits, market certifications, or ISO initiatives.

s.h: Ensure documentation and procedures meet audit requirements.
s.t:
Reporting and communication
Prepare and deliver executive-level reporting, including progress updates, KPIs, identified risks, and recommendations.
Maintain full visibility of project status and ensure accurate documentation across PM tools and systems.
Provide structured reporting and presentations to senior management and steering committees.
Who and what we are after?
Bachelor’s degree in IT, Project Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
Professional certification required: PRINCE2 Practitioner, PMP, Agile Certified Practitioner, or equivalent.
3–5+ years of proven project management experience, including at least 3 years working with software development teams or technical delivery environments.
2–3+ years of experience working in the iGaming industry or another highly regulated digital environment.
Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies.
Advanced experience with Jira and other PM tools, including reporting and workflow configuration.
Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing high-complexity projects, with strong leadership, influencing, and decision-making skills.
Proficient in risk management, governance, and change control processes.
Excellent analytical abilities, problem-solving mindset, and data-driven decision making.
Strong documentation, reporting, and technical communication skills, with the ability to lead technical discussions and coordinate with engineers during design, development, and implementation phases.
Solid written and verbal communication skills in English.

Experience with regulatory, compliance, or market entry projects.
Exposure to security frameworks such as ISO 27001.

Every contact that reaches a customer support agent, and every credit issued to customers, represents a defect somewhere in our system. This role exists to help find those defects, trace them to their source, and work with the teams responsible to eliminate them at a systemic level.
This is a high impact senior program management role within the EMEA Customer Experience organisation, reporting to the Director of Defect Elimination and Customer Experience. The Senior Program Manager is accountable for turning customer experience signals from Wolt and/or Deliveroo markets into clear, actionable insight, and for driving the resulting fixes through to resolution with partner teams.
What you’ll be doing
You will own the delivery of the defect elimination program across EMEA, including application of the defect driver taxonomy to identify where defect rate concentrates, and where customer outcomes are worst. You will build a clear, prioritised list of issues for partner teams to work through.
You will represent the voice of the customer in the rooms where decisions get made about your markets. That means preparing and presenting data in product reviews, weekly/monthly business reviews and planning sessions, so the cost of poor customer experience is concrete and attributable, and so partner teams understand what is being asked of them and why.
You will build working relationships with partner teams in engineering, marketplace operations, courier operations, and finance, and you will track the fixes they commit to through to completion. You will feed results back into the program so everyone can see what worked, and to ensure defects are eliminated for good.
You will maintain and improve the data infrastructure and reporting that underpins this work, ensuring customer experience insights are credible, available and actionable.
Our humble expectations
The right person for this role has spent time inside a large-scale customer experience or operations function, and has direct experience translating customer defects through identification, root cause analysis and resolution. They are comfortable working with imperfect data, and they know how to build a credible case when the evidence is directional rather than conclusive.
Strong analytical instincts are essential. This person needs to know what questions to ask of the data and whether the answers make sense. Prior exposure to a successful voice of the customer (VoC) program is critical.
There is a meaningful cross-functional dimension to the role. This person will spend real time getting other teams to prioritise work that benefits the customer but may compete with other priorities. That requires good judgement, clear communication, and the ability to build trust quickly with people outside their reporting line.
The role also requires the ability to drive results in a dynamic and ambiguous landscape. The right person will combine introducing structure and rigor, while being agile and responsive to changing priorities and emerging issues.
This is a high impact and high visibility role, with the opportunity to interact with stakeholders and teams across the full customer lifecycle. The role will also span across 40 EMEA Roo & Wolt markets, meaning there is an opportunity to drive financial and customer experience results at scale.
Next steps
You will first meet with our Talent Acquisition team to understand role and company fit. Then, you will meet with the Hiring Manager who will talk through your relevant experience and ask you competency based questions that assess your suitability for the role.

The third stage is an assignment, where you will be given a business problem to think through, and present back to the team. If successful, there may be a final conversation with a more senior stakeholder. Throughout all stages, you will have plenty of opportunities to ask any questions about the role, team or company.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

The ADM ensures that delivery aligns with product roadmaps, value streams, and enterprise priorities.
This role is not about managing tasks—it’s about enabling flow, clarity, and measurable outcomes that advance the organization’s customer and business goals. The ADM owns the health and predictability of the Program Increment (PI): making sure it is planned well, tracked honestly, and delivered against — while escalating risks and dependencies before they become blockers. .

s.h: The role is responsible for the following results
s.t:
Delivery Flow and Value
Consistently leveraging lean and agile practices to achieve outcomes, not just complete output.
Orchestrate planning and coordination activities across multiple teams, including PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums and cross-team synchronization, and protecting the teams against interference and over commitment, to sustain focus and health velocity.
Advise Product Owners and Business Analysts in backlog management and sequencing to ensure clear cross-team prioritization.
Monitor flow and delivery health metrics (predictability, throughput, cycle time, PI objective achievement) and share them with teams to celebrate progress and surface improvement opportunities
Use performance and progress data to increase transparency and predictability in meeting commitments to the business.
Facilitate the adoption and evolution of agile practices to continuously improve how the organization produces high quality and high value outcomes.
Align teams with strategic goals through transparent sequencing of work, clear identification of cross-team dependencies; own the identification, tracking, and mitigation of delivery risks and issues, ensuring timely resolution or escalation.
Facilitate scaled/cross-team agile events (e.g., PI Planning, System Demo, Inspect & Adapt, Scrum of Scrums) so they are productive and time-boxed, setting a consistent standard of effectiveness across teams. Team-level ceremonies remain owned by Scrum Masters. Ensure delivery standards and definitions of done are applied consistently across the teams.
Enablement & Coaching
Coach Scrum Masters, Business Owners, Product Owners and Business Analysts to communicated in terms of value delivered rather than requirement fulfillment.
Guide continuous improvement through retrospectives, delivery health checks, and root-cause analysis at the multi-team and PI Levels
Build agile maturity through mentoring, modeling psychological safety, and reenforcing learning cycles.
Stakeholder Engagement
Translate delivery progress into business impact, reporting what value was realized, not just completed.
Own upward and outward communication of delivery status, risks, and PI outcomes to executives, business owners, the Governance & Transformation Lead, and technology leadership.
Ensure the “voice of delivery” is represented in strategic planning and portfolio discussions.

PI predictability (planned vs. delivered PI objectives) across teams in scope.
Flow metrics trend (cycle time, throughput, work-in-progress) shared and improving over time.
Time-to-resolution on escalated risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies.
Stakeholder-reported clarity and trust in delivery commitments (Business Owners, executive sponsors).
Team-reported psychological safety and agile maturity progression.

creativestyle ist eine E-Commerce-Agentur mit deutsch-polnischem Setup: Projektmanagement in München, Entwicklung in Krakau und Rybnik. Über 120 umgesetzte Shops, rund 110 Leute, Kunden wie benuta, NKD, BRAX, CEWE Fotobuch, Einhell, Rieker und Bergzeit.

Jede und jeder bei uns hat einen technischen Background. Die Geschäftsführung eingeschlossen.
50% Freiheit, 50% Verantwortung. Beides gilt gleichzeitig.
Fehler sind bei uns Lektionen, keine Schuldfrage. Wir steigen nur ungern zweimal in denselben Fluss.
Corporate sind wir nicht. Unzuverlässig allerdings auch nicht – und falls du glaubst, dass sich das ausschließt, beweisen wir dir gern das Gegenteil.
Wir nehmen keine Projekte an, auf die wir keine Lust haben. Aufgeräumt wird hier nur, was wir selbst angefangen haben.
Warum wir diese Stelle gerade jetzt besetzen

1. Wir bauen unser PIM- und ERP-Geschäft aus. Ab nächstem Jahr bieten wir Pimcore und Odoo an. Wir suchen jemanden, der diese Projekte nicht nur steuert, sondern Kunden im Workshop schon den Unterschied zwischen sauberem Datenmodell und teurer Migration zeigt.
2. Wir erfinden die PM-Rolle neu: In Zeiten von KI reicht bloßes Tickets-Schreiben nicht mehr – wir sind Innovationstreiber, keine Werkbank! Bei uns geht es um messbaren Impact, echtes Produktdenken und KI-Innovationen. Du steigst also in eine Rolle ein, die du aktiv mitgestalten kannst.
Aufgaben
Deine Mission
Projekte führen – von Anfang bis Betrieb. Du verantwortest Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung großer E-Commerce-Projekte: Discovery, Konzept, Kickoff, Go-live und die Zeit danach. Technisch bewegen wir uns in Shopware, Adobe Commerce / Magento, commercetools, Pimcore und Storyblok.
Der Mensch sein, bei dem alles zusammenläuft. Du bist Hauptansprechpartner*in für unsere deutschsprachigen Kunden und die Brücke zu den Entwicklungsteams in Polen. Kundenbedürfnisse übersetzt du in saubere Lösungen, die Ideen des Teams bringst du zurück zum Kunden.
Impact – und zwar messbar. Messbar meinen wir wörtlich: Zu jeder Initiative gehören ein KPI und ein Tracking-Konzept, mit dem sich Vorher und Nachher belegen lassen.
Denken wie ein Product Owner. Behandle das Produkt wie dein eigenes! Wenn dich eine Funktion, ein Design oder eine Priorisierung nicht überzeugt, sprichst du es offen an. Bei unklarem Business Value stoppst du die Umsetzung, bis Klarheit herrscht. Die finale Entscheidung trifft der Kunde, klar – aber blind umgesetzt wird bei uns nichts.
Und der ganz normale Rest. Projektpläne, Timings, Budgets und Status-Reports hältst du zuverlässig auf Kurs. Meetings, Workshops, Sprint-Plannings und Retros moderierst du so, dass hinterher alle wissen, was Sache ist. Risiken erkennst du, bevor sie eins werden.
Deine Spezialisierung: PIM oder ERP
Hier liegt der Unterschied zu einer klassischen PM-Stelle. Eins von beidem bringst du mit:
PIM (Pimcore) – Du weißt, wie Produktdaten wirklich aussehen, bevor sie schön sind: Datenmodelle, Attribute, Varianten, Kanäle, Übersetzungen. Du hast schon mal eine Migration aus einer gewachsenen Excel-Landschaft begleitet und danach trotzdem noch an das Projekt geglaubt.
ERP (Odoo) – Bestände, Preise, Aufträge, Rechnungen, Schnittstellen. Du kannst einschätzen, was ins ERP gehört, was in den Shop und was besser in keins von beidem.
Beides mitzubringen wäre Angeberei – wir hätten aber nichts dagegen.
Du kommst aus einer vergleichbaren Welt, nur mit anderen Systemen (Akeneo, Contentserv, SAP, Business Central)? Dann sprich uns trotzdem an. Uns interessiert, ob du die Zusammenhänge verstehst, nicht welches Logo auf dem Login-Screen war.
Qualifikation
Du bist unser Mensch, wenn
Du mindestens 3 Jahre Projekte im digitalen Umfeld oder im E-Commerce geführt hast – von der ersten Idee bis in den Betrieb.
Du technisch mitreden kannst: APIs, PIM, ERP, Schnittstellen. Selbst programmieren musst du nicht. Verstehen, worüber die Devs gerade streiten, schon.
Scrum und Kanban dein Handwerkszeug sind und du Jira, Confluence und Miro im Schlaf bedienst.
Du fließend Deutsch (C2) und sehr gut Englisch sprichst – unsere Kunden sitzen im DACH-Raum, unsere Teams in Polen.
Du zwischen den Zeilen liest und Bedürfnisse erkennst, bevor sie im Briefing stehen.
Du aus einem leeren Blatt eine Roadmap machst: Backlog, Milestones, Budget, Timing.
Du KI-Tools schon im Alltag nutzt – oder große Lust hast, das in den nächsten Monaten zu ändern.
Du auch dann noch weißt, was zu tun ist, wenn der Deadline morgen und das Problem heute ist.
Pluspunkte sammelst du mit Erfahrung auf Händlerseite und mit Shopware und/oder Magento.
Wir bauen ein offenes Team. Bewirb dich unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Orientierung, Religion oder Behinderung – uns interessiert, was du kannst und wie du denkst.

Was du bei uns bekommst
70.000 – 85.000 € , abhängig von Erfahrung und Spezialisierung. Konkrete Zahlen gibt es beim ersten Gespräch, nicht erst nach der dritten Runde.
Innovationsbudget für PoCs und eigene Ideen – bewusst als Investment gedacht, nicht als Restposten.
Weiterbildungsbudget inklusive Zertifizierungen (z. B. Shopware, Pimcore, …).
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Home Office. Die Arbeit passt sich deinem Leben an, nicht umgekehrt.
Büro mit Dachterrasse im TRI München – plus MVV-Ticket, damit du auch hinkommst.
MacBook Pro und iPhone, ordentliche Peripherie inklusive.
Teamevents in Deutschland und Polen. Epische Trips nach Polen und die legendäre Revanche der polnischen Crew auf der Wiesn – eine Tradition mit Erfolgsgarantie!
Kaffee, Getränke und Obst. Muss man ja heute dazuschreiben.
Klingt nach dir?
Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung!

**Gestalten Sie die AI\-Transformation von SwissComply**
SwissComply ist ein führender Anbieter von Compliance, Risk Management und Legal Dienstleistungen für Schweizer Finanzdienstleister. Unsere Stärke liegt in der Erfahrung unserer Mitarbeitenden, fundierten Methodiken und der Fähigkeit, unsere rund 300 Kunden effizient (Nutzung von Skaleneffekten), aber auch individuell zu betreuen.
Nun entwickeln wir unsere Dienstleistungserbringung weiter: Wir wollen unsere Dienstleistungen und Prozesse systematisch durch AI unterstützen. Dafür suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die Menschen zusammenbringt, Veränderungen wirksam gestaltet und Vorhaben bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung führt.
**Ihre Aufgaben:**
Als AI Transformation Manager führen Sie unser Transformationsprogramm operativ. Sie berichten direkt an den Chief Services \& Solutions Officer (CSSO), ein Mitglied der Geschäftsleitung. Gemeinsam mit unseren Fachverantwortlichen übersetzen Sie die Strategie in konkrete, messbare Resultate.
**Ihre Verantwortlichkeiten:**
Sie strukturieren das Projektportfolio über die Business Lines, priorisieren die Vorhaben und entwickeln eine realistische Roadmap. Sie erarbeiten mit den Fachverantwortlichen Zielprozesse, Business Cases und messbare Qualitäts\- und Effizienzziele.

Sie steuern Teilprojekte, Ressourcen, Budget und Abhängigkeiten und bereiten Entscheidungen für CSSO und Geschäftsleitung vor. Sie sorgen dafür, dass gemeinsam entwickelte Lösungen im Arbeitsalltag eingesetzt werden und nachweisbaren Nutzen schaffen.

Sie begleiten unsere Mandatsleiter durch die Veränderung, moderieren unterschiedliche Interessen und organisieren Schulung und Wissenstransfer. Sie schaffen Transparenz über Fortschritt, Risiken und Ergebnisse und greifen frühzeitig ein, wenn Anpassungen notwendig sind.
**Was Sie mitbringen:**
* Langjährige Erfahrung in der Leitung anspruchsvoller Transformations\- oder Digitalisierungsprogramme
* Mehrere nachweisbar erfolgreiche Umsetzungen von der Konzeption bis zur nachhaltigen Verankerung im Betrieb
* Gute Kenntnis der Finanzindustrie, idealerweise mit Bezug zu Asset Management, Compliance oder Risikomanagement
* Praktische Erfahrung mit AI\-gestützten Veränderungen sowie ein fundiertes Verständnis von Geschäftsprozessen, Daten und Softwareentwicklung
* Die Fähigkeit, wirtschaftlichen Nutzen zu beurteilen, Prioritäten zu setzen und auch unter Unsicherheit klare Entscheidungen vorzubereiten
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse
**Wie Sie mit Menschen arbeiten:**
* Sie hören zu, fragen nach und nehmen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ernst
* Sie können erfahrene Fachspezialisten für Veränderungen gewinnen und anspruchsvolle Diskussionen respektvoll führen
* Verlässlichkeit, Empathie und konstruktiver Umgang mit Kritik zeichnen Sie aus
* Sie teilen Wissen und übernehmen Verantwortung für das gemeinsame Ergebnis
**Was Sie bei SwissComply gestalten können:**
Sie übernehmen eine zentrale Rolle mit direktem Zugang zur Geschäftsleitung und grossem Gestaltungsspielraum. Sie arbeiten mit erfahrenen RM\- und Compliance\-Spezialisten und einer umfangreichen fachlichen Wissensbasis. Ihre Arbeit prägt, wie SwissComply künftig Dienstleistungen entwickelt und erbringt.
**Interessiert?**
Wir freuen uns auf Ihren Lebenslauf und eine kurze Beschreibung von zwei vergleichbaren Vorhaben:
Welche Verantwortung hatten Sie persönlich, welche Ergebnisse wurden erreicht und was haben Sie daraus gelernt?
Im Auswahlprozess möchten wir Sie auch in einer gemeinsamen Fallarbeit kennenlernen.

Ashley Digital is the e-commerce engine behind Ashley Furniture Industries — one of the most recognized home brands in the world. As the world's largest manufacturer of home furnishings and the largest furniture store brand in North America, Ashley is in a category unto itself.

Our team sits at the intersection of world-class retail and digital innovation, driving the e-commerce experience for millions of customers across every platform and touchpoint. If you’ve shopped online for a mattress in the last decade, there’s a good chance you’ve already experienced our award-winning Nectar Sleep and DreamCloud.

We're a fast-moving, highly collaborative team operating at a transformational moment, and we're charged with shaping how people discover, explore, and buy home furnishings. Our expertise spans data science, performance marketing, product, and creative, and our work reaches millions of customers every day.

It's a rare combination: the energy of a tech company, the stability of an industry leader, and the opportunity to build something truly significant. If you're energized by transformation, collaboration, and meaningful impact at scale, Ashley Digital is where ambition meets opportunity.
To be considered for this remote opportunity, you must reside and be authorized to work within the United States.

The Strategic Program Manager is a high-impact, execution-focused role at the center of Ashley Digital's operating and reporting rhythm.

This individual will partner closely with senior leadership to own the structure and quality of the company's financial and operational reporting cadence — including MBRs, QBRs, and business infrastructure read-outs — ensuring information is accurate, well-organized, and decision-ready. At its core, this role is about synthesis and precision.

You will take financial, operational, and cross-functional inputs and translate them into sharp, structured outputs that reflect what matters most. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable operating in ambiguity and executing at a high level of detail.

Success requires strong judgment, exceptional work ethic, and the ability to consistently produce high-quality work under tight timelines.

Own the MBR/QBR process and related business infrastructure read-outs — gathering inputs, synthesizing findings, and presenting clear, decision-ready updates to the Executive team
Build concise, high-quality presentations that communicate key insights, trends, and updates with precision and clarity
Partner closely with senior leaders to shape messaging, structure communication, and maintain a consistent operating cadence
Prepare materials for executive forums, ensuring content is tightly constructed, well-supported, and aligned to key priorities
Identify key themes, risks, and opportunities across the business by connecting signals across multiple inputs, and educating cross functional teams as needed
Drive follow-through on key actions and decisions, ensuring alignment and accountability across stakeholders
Continuously improve how information is gathered, structured, and communicated across the organization
Operate as a trusted, detail-oriented partner who can independently manage critical workstreams from start to finish
The responsibilities described above are not exhaustive. You may be asked, from time to time and as reasonably required by business needs, to perform other duties consistent with your skills and role, including work for or on behalf of our related entities. This job description does not constitute a contract of employment and may be modified at any time, subject to applicable law

3-5 years of experience in high-growth technology companies, business operations, banking, consulting, or roles requiring strong written communication and cross-functional coordination with executive leadership
Bachelor's degree required; MBA, a plus.
Comfort working with financial and operational data to support executive reporting cycles.
Experience in investment banking, private equity, or management consulting (special projects/chief of staff functions) strongly preferred.
Exceptional ability to structure ambiguous problems and synthesize large amounts of information into clear, concise outputs
Strong presentation skills, with a demonstrated ability to create polished, executive-level materials
High attention to detail and consistently strong judgment on what matters and how to communicate it
Ability to operate with speed and precision in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment
Comfortable working with senior leaders and navigating cross-functional stakeholders
Strong ownership mindset and willingness to take on highly iterative, detail-oriented work
Experience in high-growth, e-commerce, or direct-to-consumer businesses is a plus
